intent.proves: List fields with options, single and multi select: values-resolve satisfies the selected profile assertion.
intent.scope: Legacy registry scope; defaultLanguage/pimShop/productScope tokens where present. Global scans remain global.

bindings.query: SELECT DISTINCT TOP 25 CAST(v.FieldValueFieldCategoryId AS nvarchar(100)) + N'|' + CAST(v.FieldValueFieldId AS nvarchar(100)) + N' = ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(s.value)) FROM EcomProductCategoryFieldValue v JOIN EcomProductCategoryField f ON f.FieldCategoryId = v.FieldValueFieldCategoryId AND f.FieldId = v.FieldValueFieldId AND f.FieldType = 15 CROSS APPLY STRING_SPLIT(CAST(v.FieldValueValue AS nvarchar(max)), N',') s WHERE LTRIM(RTRIM(s.value)) <> N'' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM EcomFieldOption o WHERE o.FieldOptionFieldId IN (N'ProductCategory|' + f.FieldCategoryId + N'|' + f.FieldId, N'ProductCategory|reference_category|' + f.FieldId) AND o.FieldOptionValue = LTRIM(RTRIM(s.value)))
